free_roam.description: Post-finish presentation policy. Required in the current v1 source.

geometry_issues.description: Geometry errors block free roam as well as course publication.

distant_path.description: Optional authored, display-only silhouette mesh in the same local frame.

notice.description: May be empty; multiline notices are preserved without normalization.

entrances.description: Author-declared access corridors, excluded from automatic placement/sidewalks.

holes.description: Strictly interior, disjoint open courtyards; flat roof.

placement_mode.description: Authoring hints only; neither field restricts checkpoint passage.

faces.description: Outward triangular faces in the document's (x,height,y) axes.

start_direction.description: Horizontal direction in map x/z coordinates. Nonzero, normalized by the consumer.

control_points.description: Joined cubic Bezier spans: 3*n+1 controls, including both road nodes.

ring_radius_cm.description: Ring aperture lies in local XY, centred at the record origin; +Z passes.

start_minutes.description: Authored starting time; authority preferences can override it.

curved_faces.description: Explicit (part, triangle) pairs forming a curved driving surface. All remaining faces retain the ordinary blocking shell role.

safety_min_cm.description: Conservative full swept envelope AND the predicted pad landing area.

control_points.description: Two points form a straight line; 3n+1 points form cubic Bezier spans.

avoid_lateral_cm.description: Centre of the lane that stays clear for the complete motion cycle.

path.description: `main` or `alternate`, never an inferred nearest road on another level.

fingerprint.description: Untrusted producer label; never authentication or an allowlist key.

surface_id.description: Ordinary road ID, or `track:<authoring instance ID>` (never array index).

asset_id.description: builtin:fence or builtin:streetlight. Authored heights are absolute.

clearance_cm.description: Required for tunnel/underpass; portals connect only explicit graph nodes.

snow_retention_percent.description: Percentage of weather snow retained on this road, including its paint.

lateral_cm.description: Half-width and normal clearance of the allowed drive/flight corridor.

ribbon_cm.description: Final analytic lane edges, quantized directly rather than offset from an already rounded centre. Dedicated structure frames use their own mesh.

paths.description: First route is the base route. Other routes include the shared start/finish.

structures.description: Explicit static collision, independent of roads and interaction lines.

terrain_integration.description: Compile as an overlay on the existing terrain document.

centerline.description: Current v1 optional geometry; populated only for a swept cylinder.

flow_cm_s.description: Map x / map y velocity, centimetres per second.

tree.description: Declared visual footprint and shared asset for generated trees.
